gen-dafont-dogica-gf-mozilla-text: Dogica's wide tracking is the first thing you notice, heavy and commanding, with lowercase climbing nearly to the capitals. Mozilla Text, a sans-serif with tall, bold-looking lowercase, keeps pace without flinching.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Commanding from the first glance, Dogica runs wide and heavy. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs follows with modern, outward-pointing terminals and an x-height rising close to cap height, so the two share a tall stance.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Heavy and wide-tracked, Dogica hits hard, its lowercase rising close to the capitals. Noto Sans Arabic takes the quieter role, with wide openings on small letters and a pronounced x-height.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Big, blunt and wide-spaced: Dogica hits like a shout, its lowercase climbing nearly to capital height with open curve endings. Noto Sans Armenian does the welcoming, with wide, inviting round letters.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Thick, loud and wide: Dogica takes up room. Noto Sans Bassa Vah brings a dominant midsection that swallows line height, plus an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali keeps its capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Dogica brings commanding weight and wide tracking, so heavy headings meet text with distinctly open letter mouths.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Heavy and commanding, Dogica has wide tracking and lowercase that rises close to the capitals. And it earns its keep big and short, while Noto Sans Buhid gives generous space between curve ends and the stem.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-carian: Loud, heavy and wide-tracked: that's Dogica all over. Noto Sans Carian offers terminals that stay apart like open scissor blades, and tiny gaps between ascender tops and the x-height line.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Commanding and heavy, Dogica sets wide tracking against lowercase that rises close to the capitals. But Noto Sans Deseret is the approachable one, with open apertures and a high, wide-looking lowercase.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Heavy from the first letter, Dogica stretches wide with lowercase rising close to capital height and open curve endings. Noto Sans Elbasan brings large lowercase and terminals that never pinch shut.
